profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary: Jack of all trades, Internet do gooder.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enhanced platform robustness via initiatives to reduce bundle size, streamline build processes, and optimize CI/CD pipelines
- Served as the maintainer of the internal component library, ensuring its reliability, scalability, and ongoing development
- Upgraded core platform libraries: Node.js, React, Apollo/GraphQL, TypeScript
- Launched the new signed in homepage as a part of the Chegg’s modernized stack with Next.js (React) and Apollo (GraphQL)
- Created a framework to add school and course to users so it can easily be used across teams
- Implemented patterns for internal analytics and logging in the Chegg component library

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated from reactive programming to React + Redux-Saga architecture to power the new contact and organization pages
- Launched Streak Upcoming using reactive programming (Kefir) and React
- Launched quick Task creation with natural language date/time processing
- Adapted InboxSDK APIs for new Gmail launch (2018), new left nav launch (2020)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Improved loan conversions by building funnel pages/components in Angular and optimize Node APIs
- Deployed multitenant client architecture for use between multiple credit union partners
- Wrote server and client tracking services for scalable reporting across the company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Launched Hudl Assist for football, creating the game tagging interface with a React + Redux front end, C# backend, and Mongo database (http://www.hudl.com/products/assist/football)
- Implemented reporting including the football drive chart report to visualize game breakdown data with React + SVG
- Wrote APIs and services to sanitize football breakdown data for use throughout Hudl
